entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivation procedure
entities.description: Procedure to deactivate an EPS bearer context or disconnect from a PDN by deactivating all EPS bearer contexts to the PDN. Initiated by the network and may be triggered by UE procedures.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: UE-initiated procedure that may trigger EPS bearer context deactivation.

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnect procedure
entities.description: UE-initiated procedure that may trigger EPS bearer context deactivation.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE to deactivate EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where EPS bearer context deactivation procedures can occur.

entities.name: CSG subscription expired or removed
entities.description: Condition where CSG subscription expires or is removed while UE is receiving emergency bearer services.

entities.name: Detach requested by HSS
entities.description: Condition where HSS requests detach for UE with emergency bearers.

entities.name: MME deactivates non-emergency EPS bearers
entities.description: MME behavior to deactivate all non-emergency EPS bearers when CSG subscription expires.

entities.name: MME preserves emergency EPS bearers
entities.description: MME behavior to not deactivate emergency EPS bearers during CSG subscription expiration.

relations.description: EPS bearer deactivation may be triggered by UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.
EPS bearer deactivation may be triggered by UE requested PDN disconnect procedure.
EPS bearer deactivation procedure involves sending DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
EPS bearer deactivation procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
CSG subscription expiration condition establishes MME behavior to deactivate non-emergency bearers.
CSG subscription expiration condition establishes MME behavior to preserve emergency bearers.
HSS detach request condition triggers sending DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST for non-emergency bearers.
